name: City Council Regular Meeting
agenda_text:
RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, JULY 12, 2023, 2023 - 6:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
 This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. The Public may join this meeting virtually or
 attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83851020916
  Webinar ID: 838 5102 0916

  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,83851020916# OR +16699009128,,83851020916#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 or +1 669 900 9128 or +1 253 205 0468

 Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor or
 the meeting chairperson. The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to
 speak must “raise their hand”, at which time they will be unmuted.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Halpern, McSweeney, Honig, Mayor Pro Tem
  Davis, Mayor Pearl

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES: None

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  4th of JULY CERTIFICATES OF RECOGNITION

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the
printed agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment
telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed on Page
1 of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior
to the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  CULTURAL RECREATION COMMITTEE REPORT – WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  2023 CITIZEN AND STUDENT OF THE YEAR; CULTURAL RECREATION
  ADVISORY BOARD APPOINTMENT – Select Dr. Ted Corwin as the 2023
  Westlake Village Citizen of the Year and Shai Adams as the 2023 Westlake Village
  Student of the Year and schedule their official recognition for the July 26, 2023 City
  Council Meeting; and appoint Finleigh Williams to the Cultural Recreation Advisory
  Board, as a student member, with the term ending December 31, 2023.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  PUBLIC HEARING REGARDING PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 21-
  002 MODIFICATION NO. 1; RESOLUTION NO. 2315-23 - Adopt Resolution No.
  2315-23, determining Modification No. 1 to Planned Development Permit No. 21-
  002 is exempt from CEQA and authorizing changes to the exterior materials and
  design of the entryway of an approved new 5,816 square foot single-family
  residence with an attached 788 square foot. garage located at 3707 Brigantine
  Circle.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2315-23: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 1 TO PLANNED DEVELOPMENT
  PERMIT NO. 21-002, AUTHORIZING REVISIONS TO THE EXTERIOR MATERIALS AND
  DESIGN OF THE ENTRYWAY OF AN APPROVED NEW SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENCE
  LOCATED AT 3707 BRIGANTINE CIRCLE
 CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective July 1, 2023 in the amount of
  $ 1,169,002.78

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  ACCEPTANCE OF COMPLETION OF THE TRAFFIC SIGNAL PAINTING
  PROJECT, PHASE 2 - City Council to accept completion of the Traffic
  Signal Painting Project, Phase 2, and authorize the City Clerk to execute
  and record a Notice of Completion on behalf of the City.

  2.  AGREEMENT WITH SECURAL SECURITY CORPORATION FOR
  SECURITY SERVICES AT THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE COMMUNITY
  PARK AND THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE DOG PARK - Approve a new
  professional services agreement with Secural Security Corporation. for
  security services at the Westlake Village Community Park and the Westlake
  Village Dog Park and authorize the Mayor to sign and execute the
  agreement on behalf of the City.

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  ADOPTION OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS, APPROVAL OF EASEMENT
  AGREEMENTS, RIGHT OF ENTRY AGREEMENTS, AND CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION, AND AUTHORIZATION TO ADVERTISE BIDS FOR THE
  FISCAL YEAR 2022-23 SIDEWALK IMPROVEMENT PROJECT AND THE
  LINDERO CANYON ROAD PARKWAY LANDSCAPE IMPROVEMENT
  PROJECT - Adopt the plans and specifications for the Fiscal Year 2022-23
  Sidewalk Improvement Project Fiscal and the Lindero Canyon Road Parkway
  Landscape Improvement Project, find the projects are exempt from CEQA;
  authorize the City Manager to executive the easement agreements and right of
  entry agreements and authorize staff to advertise bids for the construction of
  these projects.

NEW BUSINESS: None

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, July 6, 2023 at 4:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.
